uncertainty.basis: spread of the home win probability and expected total across the validated variants (chosen model, goals-only, goalie-aware under each projected goalie pairing, lineup-aware with each club's last lineup). A sensitivity, not a confidence interval.

goalies.availability_basis: CONFIRMED: a recorded starter (hockey/data/confirmed_starters.json); UNVERIFIED: a usage projection, and no NHL injury or roster feed exists to say the goalie is available; CONFLICT: a confirmation names a goalie listed unavailable

lineups.basis: each club's previous game's dressed skaters against its typical lineup (box scores; hockey/model/lineups.js). Confirmed lineups are known only at warmups, and no pregame lineup feed is wired.

lineups.note: The price uses the chosen model (ratings only). The lineup-aware variant is a sensitivity: projected lineups did not clear the selection bar; confirmed lineups changed held-out log loss by -0.000895 (95% CI -0.001696 to -0.000051).

notes: Ratios are to the league's running average (1.00 = average); xG ratings are score-adjusted and opponent-adjusted.
Ratings decay with a 180-day half-life and are shrunk toward average by a 32-game prior; early-season ratings lean on last season.

warnings: starting goalie unconfirmed for ANA: a usage projection, availability unverified (no injury feed)
starting goalie unconfirmed for OTT: a usage projection, availability unverified (no injury feed)

invalidators: A starting goalie other than the projected one (see the goalie scenarios for the size of the move).
A late scratch or return of a regular: lineups are measured but not in this price (no pregame lineup feed); the lineup block lists regulars absent from each club's last game and for how long.
A price posted by a book that settles the market differently (a 60-minute line is not the 2-way moneyline).
A back-to-back: the second-game effect is in the model, but the rested starter decision is not known yet.
